user_requirements:
系统名称: WiperControlSystem
系统描述: 控制前后雨刮器运行
组件数量: 3
组件类型: WiperController, RainSensor, MotorDriver
关键需求:
  - RainSensor检测雨量并输出模拟信号
  - WiperController实现自动/手动模式切换
  - MotorDriver控制前后雨刮电机
  - 通过CAN接收用户设置

system_analysis.functional_decomposition: RainSensor: 周期采样模拟雨量传感器并通过Sender-Receiver端口发布rain_level。WiperController: 接收rain_level与CAN用户设置，管理自动/手动模式、滤波与抖动抑制、决策生成雨刷命令并以同步调用/请求下发给MotorDriver。MotorDriver: 提供底层电机控制操作（启动/停止/速度/PWM），执行硬件抽象、故障检测与状态回报。
system_analysis.data_flow_analysis: RainSensor -> (Sender-Receiver) -> WiperController: rain_level (float, 0.0..1.0) 周期50ms异步发布。CAN -> WiperController: user_settings (enum mode, int speed_level) 异步事件触发，最大接收抖动50ms。WiperController -> MotorDriver (Client-Server): control_command (command type, speed) 同步调用，期望响应<20ms。MotorDriver -> WiperController: status (enum, error flags) 通过Sender-Receiver或回调报告。依赖关系：WiperController依赖RainSensor数据与CAN输入并依赖MotorDriver动作接口；MotorDriver依赖硬件抽象层，但对上层无直接依赖。
system_analysis.timing_requirements: RainSensor采样周期50ms；WiperController控制周期100ms（控制决策/防抖）；CAN设置异步，需在接收到后<=50ms处理并应用；WiperController到MotorDriver的同步调用端到端响应<=20ms；系统总延迟（雨量->电机动作）期望<=200ms在典型路径。
system_analysis.scalability_considerations: 组件化接口使系统可扩展为多通道（前/后雨刮）与多传感器。接口定义采用Sender-Receiver与Client-Server混合，可在大规模平台中批量复制组件实例或通过参数化端口映射扩展到N个电机。CAN接口可增添新的控制字段和诊断消息。

component_plan.name: RainSensor
component_plan.purpose: 采样并发布雨量模拟信号（rain_level）到WiperController
component_plan.behavioral_characteristics: 周期性采样50ms；对原始模拟值进行滤波与标定，阈值判定后以标准float值发布；当传感器错误检测到故障时发布fault状态；低延迟发布以支持自动模式。

interface_plan.name: RainSensor_To_WiperController
interface_plan.communication_pattern: asynchronous sender-receiver, periodic publish (50ms), latest-value semantics with optional queue of depth 1
interface_plan.performance_requirements: end-to-end latency from sample to controller <=100ms, jitter tolerance 10ms, loss-tolerant but must update every sample
interface_plan.direct_paths: RainSensor.P-port -> WiperController.R-port via runtime communication; direct SenderReceiver mapping

interface_plan.name: CAN_User_Settings
interface_plan.communication_pattern: asynchronous event-driven receiving from CAN network, event-on-arrival, processed immediately
interface_plan.performance_requirements: process within 50ms of reception, tolerate occasional duplicate messages, validate CRC and reject invalid payloads
interface_plan.direct_paths: CAN Rx stack -> WiperController R-port (mapped from CAN message)

interface_plan.name: WiperControl_To_MotorDriver
interface_plan.communication_pattern: synchronous client-server calls for control commands; blocking call with timeout and immediate acknowledgement
interface_plan.performance_requirements: call-response <=20ms, timeout handling and retry policy (1 retry), prioritized over background tasks
interface_plan.direct_paths: WiperController client -> MotorDriver server operation (synchronous call)

connection_topology.component_connections: RainSensor publishes rain_level to WiperController via IF_RainSensor_Sr; WiperController receives CAN via IF_CAN_UserSettings locally; WiperController calls MotorDriver via IF_WiperController_ClientServer. MotorDriver publishes status optionally to WiperController or system monitor.
connection_topology.data_flow_paths: Analog sensor input -> RainSensor (sample/filter) -> IF_RainSensor_Sr -> WiperController (Sensor_Process_Runnable) -> Control_Logic_Runnable -> IF_WiperController_ClientServer -> MotorDriver (Motor_Control_Runnable) -> hardware; MotorDriver status -> IF_WiperController_ClientServer response or Sender-Receiver status channel.
connection_topology.control_flow_paths: INIT sequence: all components INIT; periodic timers trigger SensorSampleEvent (RainSensor) and ControlCycleEvent (WiperController); CAN reception triggers immediate CANSettingsReceived -> Can_Rx_Runnable -> Mode_Manager; control decision triggers synchronous server-call to MotorDriver and waits for ack.

architecture_rationale.design_decisions: 采用Sender-Receiver用于周期性传感器数据以降低耦合与支持多发布者；采用Client-Server用于对电机的同步控制以保证确定性的命令确认。将感知、决策、驱动分离为独立组件以便可重用和并行开发。定周期控制与事件驱动混合以兼顾实时性与响应性。
architecture_rationale.tradeoff_analysis: 使用同步Client-Server使控制命令有明确确认和超时，但增加了阻塞风险，故将MotorDriver放在优先级更高的调度上下文并设置短超时。Sender-Receiver降低延迟与CPU负载但可能丢失样本，采用latest-value语义满足控制需求。整体复杂度中等，权衡了实时性与实现复杂度。
architecture_rationale.alternative_considerations: 可选方案一：全部使用Sender-Receiver命令而非Client-Server以避免阻塞，但会丢失确认能力；可选方案二：将MotorDriver设计为服务代理层+事件队列以实现更高并发但增加实现复杂度。对于多通道平台，可将MotorDriver抽象为参数化实例或驱动池。
architecture_rationale.risk_assessment: 主要风险为同步调用超时导致控制失效、CAN消息丢失或传感器故障。缓解措施：超时与重试策略、本地默认行为（降速或停机）、故障发布与监测。接口定义与端口契约应在Round2中精确定义以避免类型不匹配。
